title: DMP ref
description: What a message is about (section 4.3). Informative: the 512-byte limits and the one-line rule on `id` and `at` are not expressed, and a local send also refuses a `type` the host does not know.

type.description: A registered ref type (section 11.5); a received ref may carry any identifier (section 4.4).

id.description: What the ref names: a work item, a session, a file path, a commit or a message id.

at.description: For a `file` ref, the commit the path is read at.
